title: KP Article V1 RC1 economics exemplar

sourceRefs.summary: Run-contract target that explains why this generated contract exists.
User-approved 24-slice plan, preservation boundary, verification cadence, stop conditions, and human checkpoint.
Accepted provisional authoring grammar and compilation contract.

allowedWork: RC1 documentation, parser, validator, source maps, lock resolution, static compilation, accessibility, interaction manifests, deck derivation, CodeMirror language tooling, draft persistence, universal development toolbar, and the economics source migration.
Focused and boundary tests, visual captures, production-closure checks, performance checks, Theseus records, and one independently reversible commit per slice.
disallowedWork: Lesson layout, graph styling, salience, or choreography redesign.
Arbitrary executable article code, prose transclusion, explicit slide syntax, advanced semantic-history tooling, or another lesson migration.
Public Web, Public Editor, SvelteKit expansion, Canvas/WebGL/Graph3D work, animation-library promotion, or deletion of legacy economics sources before the human checkpoint.
goal: Implement the approved KP article RC1 contract through one trustworthy economics authoring path, then stop for human review before freezing v1 or deleting legacy sources.
commitCadence: Commit every independently reversible verified slice with exact path staging and completed Theseus evidence.
stopConditions: Stop at HUMAN_CHECKPOINT after s23; s24 requires fresh human approval of the economics RC1 exemplar.
Stop if the grammar requires a fifth directive, layout syntax, executable article code, prose duplication, or more than 25 percent source noise.
Stop if import locking cannot reproduce the selected vignette or migration changes learner-visible semantics or animation checkpoints.
Stop if toolbar rollout introduces production JavaScript or layout shift, or if static search, HTML/MathML/SVG, direct links, accessibility, or last-valid preview regresses.
Stop if unrelated dirty-worktree files would need modification or required verification cannot be repaired inside the current slice rollback boundary.
